title: Prediction model training method, data processing device and system
assignee: Beijing Yizhen Xuesi Education Technology Co Ltd

pse.problem: Inefficient training of prediction models in federated learning systems due to large calculated amounts.
pse.solution_function: A method for training predictive models by performing forward and backward propagation between two machine learning models. Forward propagation involves using first tuning parameters from the second data processing device to generate biases, sending these biases to the second data processing device, receiving a fusion parameter, and using it for further calculations. Backward propagation involves sending the loss value of the second machine learning model to the first machine learning model.
pse.solution_structure: First and second data processing apparatuses, first and second machine learning models, user characteristic sample data.
pse.solution_implementation: 1. Receiving first user characteristic sample data from a second data processing device; 2. Determining training samples based on the first and second user characteristic sample data; 3. Sending the training samples to the second data processing device for input into the second machine learning model; 4. Forward propagation: receiving, generating, and sending biases; 5. Back propagation: receiving loss value from the second machine learning model.
pse.effect: Improved training efficiency of the prediction models by reducing the calculated amount.
